<MethodEndpoint
  method={'post'}
  path={'/v1/onboardings/{id}/pending-connector/reconcile'}
  context={'endpoint'}
></MethodEndpoint>

For an onboarding parked on an asynchronous connector whose callback has not arrived: asks the provider for the verdict it holds and, when there is one, applies it exactly as the callback would have been — same lock, same transition, same client notification. `still_pending` means the provider has not decided and nothing changed; `superseded` means the onboarding left that park between the read and the apply. Every outcome is written to the audit trail under the operator who asked.
